tests.name: PSTF JSON validation
tests.covers: Validates epic-11 artifacts and referenced relay-strategy PSTF JSON files.

tests.name: Backend relay policy and projection tests
tests.covers: Independent service/browser/ContextVM config sources, NIP-51/NIP-65 publication, fail-closed missing browser relay set, OK/zero-accepted publish failure surfacing.

tests.name: Browser discovery and encrypted ContextVM tests
tests.command: cd web && npm test -- --run tests/unit/discovery-store.test.js tests/unit/encrypted-controlplane.test.js
tests.covers: ContextVM relay normalization, degraded browser fallback, encrypted capability gating, EVENT/EOSE/CLOSED/AUTH callback handling.

tests.name: Operator discovery and CLI relay precedence tests
tests.covers: CLI --relay/env/bootstrap precedence, trusted service-authored 30002 discovery, ContextVM relay preference, EOSE and deterministic failure paths.

tests.name: AUTH/CLOSED relay-unavailable tests
tests.command: go test ./internal/adapters/nostr ./pkg/client ./cmd/cli ./internal/fipsbridge && cd web && npm run test:unit -- --run tests/unit/nostr-client-parsing.test.js tests/unit/discovery-store.test.js tests/unit/controlplane-requests.test.js tests/unit/encrypted-controlplane.test.js
tests.covers: NIP-42 AUTH callbacks, auth-required relay exclusion, OK=false preservation, CLOSED post-acceptance failures, and no mutation fallback after relay acceptance.

tests.name: NIP-34 repository relay preference tests
tests.covers: 30617 relay tag preservation, 30618 branch/state lookup through repository relays first, degraded global fallback, incomplete EOSE metadata.

tests.name: SoulFactory ngit relay separation tests
tests.covers: OpenClaw runtime/control relays separate from required NgitRelays and repeated ngit --relay support.

tests.name: NIP-86 relay administration boundary tests
tests.covers: Disabled-by-default NIP-86, secure opt-in targets, payload-bound NIP-98, authorized administrator pubkeys, HTTP/relay error surfacing, ContextVM mutation rejection.

tests.name: Documentation relay strategy search review
tests.command: grep/search review for relay taxonomy, NIP-11/NIP-66 advisory text, NIP-51 10050 boundaries, NIP-86 boundaries, and legacy 31974 usage
tests.covers: Docs reflect changed Nostr integration, CLI behavior, relay settings, optional metadata/DM bounds, and legacy discovery migration-only wording.

tests.name: Documentation terminology validation
tests.command: RepoPrompt file_search checks for current-bootstrap legacy 31974 wording and stale 5980/7980 production wording in docs
tests.covers: Documentation files touched for this epic contain no current-bootstrap 31974 wording; remaining legacy encrypted-kind references are historical investigation notes only.
